children: Kiora appointed Keith Lane as Executive Vice President, Head of Clinical Development and Regulatory Affairs, effective September 8, 2026.
Executive Vice President, Head of Clinical Development and Regulatory Affairs

Former CSO of Ora, Inc. (Sept 2025–July 2026); prior SVP & Therapeutic Area Head-Posterior Segment at Ora (Oct 2019–Sept 2025); oversaw clinical ops and regulatory strategy for 60+ ophthalmic trials including 12 global Phase 3 pivotal studies; experience across small molecules, biologics, gene and cell therapies in retinal and other eye diseases.
